title: Listening Drill — Growing cress
description: Practical demonstration. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Growing cress
sections.transcript:
INSTRUCTOR: This demonstration is about setting up a cress trial. Watch the whole process once before trying it yourself. If you start while I'm still talking, you may miss the order of the steps.

INSTRUCTOR: Get the cotton pads ready. Begin by checking the drainage hole. When everything is in position, wait six minutes. It may look as though nothing is happening at first.

INSTRUCTOR: Look for even moisture before moving on. wipe away any water on the bench. Leave yourself time to clear the work area so the next group can start promptly.
